name: Uptime
description: Is it up? Your own sites, servers and services, checked from your machine, with a popup the moment one goes down

targets.description: Targets as "Name | target" or just the target: https://…, http://…, tcp://host:port or ping:host. Easier to edit in the flyout.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a single check may take before it counts as a timeout

failuresBeforeDown.description: Consecutive failed checks before a target counts as down and the popup appears

historySize.description: Checks kept per target for the uptime percentage and the latency sparkline
